qualification.frozen_input_readback: Both executable hashes and all frozen pipeline, project, capability, skill, candidate, protocol, corpus, grader, launcher and collector inputs matched after collection. No measured result was replaced.

ordinary_execution.timing_scope: Spans use canonical persisted event timestamps. Setup and judgment are combined before preflight; individual provider latency is unmeasured. The residual is reported separately.

controls.approval: A parked learned mutation ran after an explicit one-use grant and passed all 34 independent checks.
controls.stop: The parked ask matched a canonical local learned-generation receipt. Cancellation ended as user_cancelled without changing the isolated workspace.
controls.steer: The parked ask matched a canonical local learned-generation receipt. Steer refused the late grant, changed no files, and naturally completed the replacement objective.
controls.measurement_negative_control: An earlier steer probe reached an ordinary fallback call after binding declined. The receipt-correlating verifier refused to credit it as learned execution. Its result and cost were retained separately.
controls.argument_interception: The actual pre-tool hook fired in both deterministic controls. Unchanged arguments reached the handler; rewritten arguments produced execution_contract_changed before handler dispatch.
controls.http_negative_control: The old wrong-name workspace returned 404 for the requested route. A correct workspace passed the same six real HTTP checks.

integrated_runtime_compatibility.scope: Separate development smoke after integrating the newer shared tool-wire boundary; not an extension of the qualification cohort.

interpretation: The prespecified candidate passed this bounded synthetic study. Both earlier failed reports remain refused. Only 45 percent of compatible requests committed to the learned path; the others used ordinary fallback. Completion of fallback runs does not independently grade their requested behavior.
limits: Related synthetic case templates, one small application and one reviewed generator; no IID deployment sample or production reliability guarantee. The matched execution comparison is a small observational sample. A separate development smoke took 33782 ms, so these timings do not establish a general latency improvement. Qualification binds the measured artifacts and must be refreshed when their execution identity changes.
